title: Ringo Starr attends Playboy party | 1973
content:
Ringo Starr attended a Playboy party on 8 April 1973.

The Los Angeles event was to honour Marilyn Cole, the magazine’s new Playmate of the Year.

  • 1963: Julian Lennon is born
